name: @561-group/okaga
description: okaga — the ELITE-like space game on @561-group/tsander. You are a pilot flying between star systems in a terminal WIREFRAME cockpit. The galaxy is NOT a seeded RNG: it is the FOLD of the federated trace — a star is settled only by VISITING it (unvisited = ⊥ fog, drawn as a dim flicker), and where two pilots' traces DISAGREE about a system the substrate holds it ⊤ — a CONTESTED 'Schrödinger star' rendered DOUBLED and SHIVERING, owned by both factions, neither erased. Trade rides the cost-graph (a cut-vertex system is a monopoly, a bridge-edge lane a chokepoint). You program your ship's flight computer in a little @561-group/horsetail snippet whose four-valued result steers it: a ⊤ result honestly runs BOTH arms, held contested. THE LAW: ⊤ held, append-only trace, evidence linear. Named okaga; rides okaga's engine tsander as tsander←Tsander.

scripts.test: node tests/galaxy.test.mjs && node tests/trade.test.mjs && node tests/ship.test.mjs && node tests/game.test.mjs
